snippet.title: Big Win Hockey Trailer (Google Play)
snippet.description:
Now available for FREE on the Google Play Store for Android devices! 
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hotheadgames.google.free.bigwinhockey

It's time to hit the ice with Big Win Hockey! From the opening face off to final buzzer Big Win Hockey is the game for everyone. 

★★★★★ "If you enjoy hockey, this is a fun game to try"
★★★★★ "Can't get enough of this game"

CREATE your own unique dream team, COMPETE against opponents from around the world, WATCH your team battle it out on the ice, BOOST your player's passing, shooting, skating and other skills and get ready to hoist the Daily Trophy for the ultimate BIG WIN! 

HIGHLIGHTS 
★ Full team and player customization allowing you to create your own fantasy team! 
★ Open Bronze, Silver and Gold card packs to find new players, skill boosts to improve your team and collect other cards to stay at the top of the standings
★ Play game-changing Big Impact cards and watch them affect the outcome when they come to life as the exciting on-ice action unfolds! 
★ Earn coins and Big Bucks by playing matches, leveling up and winning the Daily Trophy so you can open more card packs! 

BIG IMPACT CARDS 
★ Howitzer!
★ Big Hits 
★ Tape to Tape
★ Sharpshooter
★ Offensive Draws
★ Defensive Draws
★ Puck Luck 
★ Puck Magnet 
★ Dangler
★ Injury Free 
★ and many more...

Now available for Android users on Google Play Store

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hotheadgames.google.free.bigwinhockey
